scope: Evaluation quality-control queue; original judgments remain unchanged.

reviews.trigger: Cross-case evidence-language consistency: two judgments describe missing spiral binding and an open-book structure but assign fail versus partial. The boundary between independent paper and an adjoining page also merits a common visual check.
reviews.observed_scope: Supervisor inspected source and all four output frames at 2.5 seconds. Style conversion and broad roles visually match the recorded descriptions. This spot check does not verify continuous motion.
reviews.review_instructions: Use the unchanged frozen card. Present anonymous source/output groups at start, middle and end, and object-region crops if needed. Do not expose method, generator prompt, initial labels or preferred ranking. Record whether the binding/page structure and two-object distinction are visible, with unknown when boundaries cannot be established. Apply the same partial criterion to all four cases. Preserve original scores and report agreement/sensitivity separately before deciding whether a systematic protocol revision is required.
